Shared with You runtime vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Shared with You support in the binary covers storefront language. Messages link handling and each host app's For You shelf actually separate runtime surfacing from product-page copy:

  • Shared with You on device — system feature: when someone shares a link, photo, song, podcast episode, article, or TV title in Messages, that content can appear in Shared with You shelves inside Photos, Safari, Music, Podcasts, News, and TV. Does not generate Chinese App Store listing text.
  • Photos For You → Shared with You — photos and videos shared in Messages collected into a Photos shelf. Listing copy may mention 与你共享 or 共享照片; indexing shared media is platform work, not Connect metadata.
  • Safari Start Page → Shared with You — links shared in Messages surfaced on Safari's start page. Listing copy covers screenshot caption lines — not Safari link-preview engineering.
  • Music & Podcasts Listen Now → Shared with You — songs and episodes shared in Messages appear in Listen Now shelves. Listing rewrite describes buyer-visible For You rows — not Apple Music API integration.
  • News & TV Shared with You shelves — articles and shows shared in Messages collected into host-app For You sections. Product-page copy names that cross-app discovery story.
  • Link previews & rich metadata — Messages renders link cards when URLs are shared. Listing copy describes shared-link value on screenshots — not LPMetadataProvider or Messages.framework implementation.
  • In-app Shared with You UI — runtime strings on shelf headers, link rows, or attribution chips inside the app. Listing rewrite does not cover String Catalog entries rendered after install.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Shared with You support in the binary.

An app that surfaces or markets Shared with You content and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Shared with You, 与你共享, and For You shared media value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement Messages link handling or host-app shelf indexing in code.

FAQ

Does Shared with You support auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Apple Shared with You surfaces content shared in Messages across Photos, Safari, Music, Podcasts, News, and TV at runtime. That system behavior does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Shared with You, From Messages, For You shared media, 与你共享, 来自信息的共享内容, 共享链接, 共享照片, 共享音乐, and 共享播客 — rewritten from your English originals.

How is this different from Messages hub and Shared Albums pages?

Shared with You listing copy covers Messages-originated content in For You shelves — links, photos, music, podcasts, and articles surfacing across host apps. Messages listing copy covers general chat, iMessage, group chats, and tapbacks — 信息. Shared Albums listing copy covers collaborative album invitations — 共享相簿. Each surface has a separate guide.

How is this different from Photos hub and Spotlight pages?

Photos listing copy covers general library browsing, albums, and Memories — not Messages-originated Shared with You as the hero. Spotlight listing copy covers system search and Siri Suggestions — not For You Shared with You shelves fed by Messages.

Why do my Shared with You screenshot captions still say Shared with You in English on China?

Screenshot overlay lines and caption fields are per localization in App Store Connect. If you never filled zh-Hans caption fields — or pasted English into the Chinese screenshot set — China buyers see Latin script on frames meant to signal 与你共享 or 来自信息的共享内容 value.

Should zh-Hans copy use 与你共享 or 来自信息的共享内容?

与你共享 matches Apple's shelf label across host apps. 来自信息的共享内容 fits frames that emphasize Messages as the content origin. 共享链接, 共享照片, and 共享音乐 fit content-type rows. 信息 fits general chat on the Messages guide. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English claims and screenshot frames.
